title: Apollo Changelog: March 13, 2023
body_markdown:
## More manageable GraphOS organizations


Two new features in[Apollo Studio](https://studio.apollographql.com/) make it easier than ever to manage your organization.


Your graphs are now all in one place and *searchable* , so you can find what you need with fewer clicks!


There’s also a new breakdown of billing usage on the dashboard tab for organization admins.


## Avoiding GraphQL pitfalls


In our latest Summit short, Stephen Spalding from Netflix warns us about “microservice madness” and “schema anarchy”.


## Dynamic templates in Rover


[Rover 0.13.0](https://github.com/apollographql/rover/releases/tag/v0.13.0) now fetches[subgraph templates](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/graphos/graphs/creating-a-subgraph/#starting-from-a-template) from a GraphQL API, meaning users can get access to new templates without waiting for a new release of Rover! With this change, we’re also[opening up submissions](https://github.com/apollographql/templates) of community templates, so if you’d like your very own subgraph template to be available from Rover, submit an issue.


## Rapid roundup


- [Apollo GraphQL is one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise of 2023](https://www.apollographql.com/blog/life-at-apollo/apollo-graphql-is-one-of-fast-companys-most-innovative-companies-in-enterprise-of-2023/)
- [Apollo Server 4.5.0](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-server/releases/tag/%40apollo%2Fserver%404.5.0) was released with several improvements to the landing page.
- [Apollo Subgraph Compatibility Tests 1.2.1](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-federation-subgraph-compatibility/releases/tag/1.2.1) enables testing for more server implementations


## Community spotlight


Volvo Car Mobility’s blog series on Federation continues[with a new post on subgraph dependencies](https://medium.com/volvo-car-mobility-tech/subgraph-dependencies-in-apollo-federation-using-requires-and-external-489ef373fb61) . Be sure to check out the whole series to learn about their journey!
